report.materials: Existing scanned dirt maps; vertex-colored curved grass; rough earth, roots and embedded pebble surfaces.
limitations: Local berm relief retains the source ledge cells; global physical elevation is not inferred.
Instanced plant shapes repeat; no claim of photoreal acceptance.
